notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update[/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]This patch marks an important milestone for our Steam Playtest: it lays down the foundations for accessibility, clarity, and smoother multiplayer battles.[/p][p][/p][p]With a brand-new tutorial, improved UI elements, and tons of bug fixes, this update is all about making the game more approachable while polishing the core RTS, deckbuilding and auto battler experience.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Tutorial Map[/b][/h3][p]Finally here: a dedicated tutorial map to introduce new players to the basics of the game. Perfect for newcomers and a great refresher for veterans.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Player Rank Icons[/b][/h3][p]Lobby and player lists now show rank icons for each player, adding flair and making progression more visible.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level Cap Notification[/b][/h3][p]At the end of each match, you’ll now see whether you’ve reached the maximum level.
👉 For this Playtest, the cap is set to [b]Level 5[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Bases are easier to tell apart with improved color coding.[/p][/*][*][p]Team recognition improved thanks to reworked spawners.[/p][/*][*][p]Base capture is now clearly displayed with a percentage bar and instant update notifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Finished base captures are more visually impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer maps updated with rebalanced player starting positions.[/p][/*][*][p]MiniMap pings are now much more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Help window reworked for better accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screen redesigned and now includes useful gameplay tips.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharper text across the board for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]All text input fields now support extended functionality.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where destroyed building plots couldn’t be reused.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where newly spawned units would occasionally ignore collision with a unit standing directly in front of the spawner, causing overlap/passing through.[/p][/*][*][p]Supply drops with rockets/missiles sometimes ignored helicopters ==> corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles now drive at the correct speed in all situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed vehicles stopping despite having space to move.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Card corrections.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fullscreen-only startup issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor now resets properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed failed login attempt issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Server list bugs corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby crash fixed when a player was kicked.[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of smaller fixes and polish passes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Community Thanks[/b][/h2][p]A huge thank you to everyone participating in the Playtest and sharing feedback – especially regarding the new Tutorial. Your input is invaluable and helps us make the game more accessible and enjoyable for both new and veteran commanders. ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield,
[b]General Front[/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Patchlog: v0.4.10.40

After several dev logs and early previews, this patch brings all the announced [b]light, medium, and heavy helicopter units[/b] into the game – including [b]15 brand-new player cards[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]It’s the biggest content update since the start of the Playtest – and it fundamentally changes the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🛩️ New Helicopter Units: Full Deployment[/h3][p]✅ All previously revealed light helicopters are now fully playable. ✈️ Medium and heavy air support units have been added, focused on [b]firepower[/b], [b]armor[/b], and [b]special abilities[/b]. 🧠 NPCs now actively use helicopters for both [b]defense and offense[/b] – be ready for anything![/p][p]⚖️ [b]Each helicopter type brings unique advantages:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Light:[/b] Very fast and agile – perfect for precise, hit-and-run tactics[/p][/*][*][p][b]Medium:[/b] Versatile with strong firepower[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy:[/b] Slow but extremely durable – ideal for breaking enemy lines[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🃏 15 New Player Cards in the Deck Builder[/h3][p]With this update, 15 brand-new helicopter cards are now available in the deck builder.[/p][list][*][p]Rarities range from [b]Common[/b] to [b]Epic[/b][/p][/*][*][p]All cards are available immediately in the Playtest[/p][/*][*][p]Expand your air strategy and create new deck synergies[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚙️ Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]General [b]performance optimizations[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Life indicators are now drawn directly[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]readability[/b] of small text on cards[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a rare bug when opening the [b]codex[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Multiple minor issues resolved:[/p][list][*][p]Corrected card stack display[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game time and resource display[/p][/*][*][p]Improved text alignment in the chat input field[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HP/DPS value display on cards[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected error message formatting in the deck builder[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare end-of-map notes.title: Patchlog: v0.4.9.39
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h3][b]🚧 Roadmap v1.0 Progress[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Quality of Life Features: 40% ==> 45%[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now assign [b]location hotkeys[/b] using [b]Ctrl + F1 to F4[/b], and recall them simply with F1 to F4.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]active spawner[/b] (including enemy spawners and the frontline) is now clearly displayed on the [b]minimap[/b]. Turret and building point selections are also visualized.[/p][p]• [b]Active spawner [/b]• [b]Enemy spawner [/b]• [b]Current frontline[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]✨ Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All [b]minimap images have been reworked[/b], now also showing the positions of available spawners.[/p][/*][*][p]A new quest and quest updates are now [b]communicated more clearly[/b] to the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special rewards[/b] (from operating plans, missions, or special orders) now appear in a [b]separate, dedicated section[/b] on the victory screen, making them easier to notice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⚖ Balancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Missile Master Gun[/b] has received a [b]significant buff[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the lobby would close immediately if the host left.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented players from creating or joining a new lobby after a failed lobby join attempt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused an error message to appear when quitting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade launchers on vehicles and turrets sometimes refused to fire at moving targets – this is now fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Infantry units no longer pause briefly after taking out an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Turrets and vehicles now switch directly to the next target instead of rotating back to idle first.[/p][/*][*][p]Turret rotation is now less juddery, especially at close range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some cards did not receive XP at the end of a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect ping display in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers are now more clearly visible during combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for joining the free playtest - your feedback helps shape the game with every update![/p][p]
See you on the battlefield,
[b]General Front[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patchlog: v0.4.9.38
notes.notes:
[u][b]Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Optimized text rendering across all areas.
[*] Increased the amount of certain loot rewards from booster packs and level-ups.
[*] Increased the number of booster credits granted upon leveling up.
[*] Rewards from booster packs and level-ups are now categorized from Common to Epic, making it easier to recognize whether a reward is high or low.
[*] Improved the display of the Steam card.
[*] Various minor UI improvements.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of available mission plans was displayed incorrectly after rerolling a mission.
[*] Replaced all in-game fonts with Unicode-compatible versions. The game now correctly handles usernames containing non-Latin characters. As a result, the workaround from 2025-05-25 is no longer necessary.
[*] Fixed an issue where the ping indicator was not shown in the lobby.
[/list]

notes.title: 📰 Retrospective & Outlook – Missions, Boosters & Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes:
Since the last major update on May 11, 2025, a lot has happened with Frontline Protocol. Even though the playtest was only unlocked shortly after the update, now is the perfect time for new players to jump in – because:

✅ Update 0.4.9.35: Missions & New Booster Packs
The game has been expanded with key features:

[list]
[*] Dynamic mission system with 1–3 maps, random modifiers, and special rewards
[*] New booster packs with revised drop logic and visual overhaul
[*] Co-op focus: Special commands and deployment plans offer new strategic options in team play
[*] New card designs & booster graphics for better readability during matches
[/list]

📋 Tip: You’ll find all the details in the in-game changelog or on our website.

🛠️ What’s Next?
The system for individual card upgrades is currently in development and already well underway. Soon, you’ll be able to upgrade cards directly – adding even more depth to deck building and long-term progression.

🚀 Now Playable on Steam!
The official Steam page for Frontline Protocol is now live – including playtest access for anyone interested.

🎮 👉 Play for free now

I truly appreciate every comment, wishlist add, and piece of feedback.
Let’s make the most of this project together!


Thank you so much for your support – feedback and wishlists help the project tremendously!
General Front ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Hotfix: v0.4.9.36
notes.notes:
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
- Improved the readability of card texts (adjustments to font sizes, contrast, and layout).


[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- Server connections at game start now tolerate slightly higher ping values. Previously, only near-perfect ping connections were accepted.
[i]Note: We're still welcoming feedback on connection quality to help improve the infrastructure for the upcoming Early Access.[/i]

- Fixed an issue where the game client could occasionally crash during the initial connection phase.
